caption: A vibrant, spicy ramen broth glows beneath a generous mound of shredded cabbage and chopped green onions. Served in a white ceramic bowl with a red spoon, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the glass.
The spicy broth is orange-red, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions, with a mound of shredded cabbage centered on top.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A glossy red spoon with a smooth, curved surface and slightly worn handle edge.
